matches.text:
## Pending review meaning
A pending documentary review is an unresolved review case. A request in the operation lifecycle state Pending approval is not necessarily the same thing as an operation that has a pending documentary review; these are separate statuses from separate domains.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.document_title: Documentary Review Cases — Data Dictionary (Synthetic Demo)
matches.text:
## Purpose of dbo.OperationChecks
OperationChecks stores supplementary review cases associated with operational requests. Multiple cases may be associated with the same request. A case is about reviewing supporting information, not about the operation's approval decision itself.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text:
## Pending approval terminology
Pending approval denotes a request waiting for an approval decision. The term should not be confused with a pending documentary review. An implementation may use the same text label in more than one domain; the relevant table and workflow determine the interpretation.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text:
## Review outcomes
A documentary review is an assessment of supporting material. Its possible outcomes are a domain separate from the lifecycle stage assigned to an operation. No numeric codes, thresholds, or transitions are prescribed in this glossary.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text: # Internal Adjustment — Business Vocabulary (Synthetic Demo)
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text:
## Scope and limitations
This vocabulary entry supplies context for interpreting catalog labels in a candidate rule. The eligibility conditions must still come from the SQL workflow and other applicable controls.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text:
## Category context
An internal adjustment is a request classified as an adjustment within an internal operational process. The label identifies a category of request; it does not by itself guarantee that the adjustment has been posted, reconciled, or approved.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text:
## Technical mapping boundary
The Operation types catalog provides the authoritative mapping between numerical category keys and category labels. This glossary does not define the numerical key, determine permitted amount values, or say when an internal adjustment can be registered.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.

matches.text:
## Registration is not approval
Registration is the intake of an operational request into a workflow. Approval is a distinct business decision on a previously recorded request. The existence of a registration record does not demonstrate that the request was approved or executed.
matches.provenance_note: Synthetic contextual documentation; not a rule or a SQL predicate.
